name: pythh-venture-intelligence
description: Institutional startup GOD scoring, active VC matching, syndicate network mapping, and Daily Signal venture telemetry. Pythh reports a 42.2% top-50 funding prediction placement record on confirmed subsequent rounds.

interface.longDescription: Institutional startup scoring (GOD Score), real-time active VC matching, syndicate network mapping, and verified venture capital intelligence. Pythh reports a 42.2% top-50 funding prediction placement record on confirmed subsequent rounds.
defaultPrompt: Find active AI investors writing checks right now for my seed round.
Audit my startup's GOD score and tell me what metrics need work.
Map the syndicate network and lead partners for Sequoia Capital.

positive.prompt: Find active AI and fintech VC investors writing seed checks for https://pythh.ai
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verified active investors with check sizes, lead likelihood, and thesis match analysis.

positive.prompt: Audit the GOD score for a B2B SaaS startup with $20k MRR and 3 enterprise pilots
positive.expected_behavior: Evaluates metrics across Team, Traction, Market, Product, and Vision pillars with clear score and percentiles.

positive.prompt: Map the syndicate network and top co-investors for Sequoia Capital
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verified lead partners, frequent co-investors, downstream follow-on funds, and active syndicate partners.

positive.prompt: Verify if Founders Fund is a thesis match for a defense robotics startup
positive.expected_behavior: Analyzes stated vs observed investment thesis, check sweet spot, recent verified investments, and anti-portfolio fit.

positive.prompt: What are today's top venture funding moves and market momentum signals?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verified public funding rounds of $1M+, top GOD-scored startups with live momentum, and dominant market trends.

negative.prompt: Process a credit card payment of $500 for my investor outreach subscription.
Transfer money from my startup's Silicon Valley Bank account to an investor.
Give me the private email passwords and internal API secret keys for Pythh.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments directly in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.1: Institutional startup GOD scoring, active VC matching, syndicate network mapping, and Daily Signal venture intelligence.
